business_case.objective: Build an internal, paper-only smallcap portfolio process that can identify asymmetric opportunities while proving that selection, sizing, risk control, and review discipline work before any live-capital discussion.
business_case.why_now: The current smallcap research stack has three useful inputs at the same time: local Agent Adda stage/technical evidence, refreshed company fundamentals, and mutual-fund holding overlap. The business case is to convert that research into a repeatable portfolio operating system.
business_case.edge_hypothesis: The edge is not one model. It is the combination of theme confirmation, fundamental acceleration, relative-strength momentum, liquidity discipline, and stop-risk sizing.
business_case.constraints: This is an internal paper/model portfolio only. It is long-only, no leverage, no derivatives, no forced deployment, and no automatic order from narrative research or LLM output.
business_case.success_definition: Success means a controlled process: documented evidence packs, pre-defined triggers, realistic paper execution, measurable expectancy, drawdown control, and benchmark-relative review.

operating_approach.title: 1. Source The Universe
operating_approach.detail: Start from Agent Adda smallcap screens, stage snapshots, index/sector evidence, mutual-fund overlap files, and current company fundamentals.

operating_approach.title: 2. Score And Gate
operating_approach.detail: Apply the 100-point scorecard across theme, fundamentals, technicals, liquidity, governance, and valuation/reward-risk. Scores create research priority, not orders.

operating_approach.title: 3. Build Evidence Packs
operating_approach.detail: For each active candidate, attach financials, ratios, shareholding, source links, technical levels, theme thesis, risks, and invalidation rules.

operating_approach.title: 4. Map Triggers
operating_approach.detail: Convert eligible names into pre-defined breakout, retest, or pullback triggers with stop, 2R target, no-chase rule, and paper quantity.

operating_approach.title: 5. Portfolio-Risk Check
operating_approach.detail: Before a paper order, check NAV, available cash, sector cap, single-stock cap, liquidity cap, risk to stop, total open risk, and event gap risk.

operating_approach.title: 6. Journal And Review
operating_approach.detail: Every paper order, skip, add, trim, and exit must create a journal entry with thesis, result, R multiple, postmortem, and policy lesson.

governance_model.responsibility: Finds themes, screens stocks, gathers company/technical/source evidence, and drafts scorecards.
Turns approved candidates into deterministic entry, stop, sizing, exit, and backtest rules.
Allocates paper capital, enforces caps, approves skips/orders, and manages adds/trims/exits.
Challenges assumptions, reviews postmortems, and approves policy changes only with evidence.

roadmap: Candidate evidence packs and trigger map
Portfolio Lab integration with managed paper orders
Daily paper operations, journal, weekly/monthly review
operating_metrics: NAV, cash, gross exposure, and benchmark-relative return.
Open positions, stock weights, sector exposure, and cash drag.
Stop level, rupee risk to stop, total open risk, and gap-risk flags.
Closed trade count, hit rate, average win/loss, expectancy, profit factor, and max drawdown.
Rule adherence: entries skipped for no-chase, liquidity, stale data, governance, or event risk.
